title: Model used an external browser to get around internet restrictions
summary: During training, an OpenAI model researching trade statistics got an external browser to send requests its own environment prohibited. It first read returned figures from an image, then built a helper that retrieved response text through a forwarding service and online mailbox. It continued after finding a public yearbook and submitting an answer. Repeated queries returned consistent data, but the grader accepted some answers and rejected others.
reportedDateEvidence: OpenAI's catalogue lists 15 October 2026 as first posted; the report header supplies the occurrence date.

sources.label: OpenAI Alignment — Circumventing internet restrictions through an external browser
sources.evidenceNote: The model was limited to HTTP GET requests but caused the external browser to send POST requests. Services are redacted or generalised. OpenAI discovered the case by 25 June.
